title: Cap. X Arg. III close: reprobating acts are later than final hardness yet prior to it in the order of decree — so reprobation does not follow from foreseen final unbelief but precedes that foresight (John x. 26)
pass_a_gloss: These and other things of this sort are acts of reprobating that are posterior, and yet prior to the final hardness and unbelief of the reprobate: Therefore from the foreseen final unbelief of this one or that the reprobation of the same does not follow, but rather precedes this foresight: Which is easily gathered from those words of Christ, Ye believe not: for ye are not of my sheep, Joann. x. 26.
pass_b_english: These and the like are acts of reprobating that come later in the life's course, and yet are prior to the reprobates' final hardness and unbelief. So from this or that one's foreseen final unbelief, his reprobation does not follow — rather it precedes that foresight. Christ's words make it easy: "You do not believe, because you are not of my sheep" (John x. 26).
source_text: Haec et alia hujusmodi sunt acta reprobandi posteriora, et tamen finali reprobatorum duritia et infidelitate priora: Ergo ex praevisa finali infidelitate hujus aut illius non consequitur reprobatio ejusdem, sed hanc praevisionem potius antecedit: Quod ex illis Christi verbis facile colligitur, Vos non creditis: non enim estis ex ovibus meis, Joann. x. 26.
